 LOSC Lille 2 – 2 Live 45' Galatasaray Diaoune 7', 39' Akgün 2' Batrakov 44' Live Updated a few seconds ago LOSC Lille vs Galatasaray LIVE Score Updates: Batrakov ties the game (2-2)
 Get real-time updates on LOSC Lile vs Galatasaray live coverage, minute by minute of the 2026-27 UEFA Champions League Matchday 3 with VAVEL.
 Coverage by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma Updated October 21, 2026, 1:33 pm ET ADVERTISEMENT
 Live Last update 1:33 PM ET 45' 1:32 PM ET 2 minutes ago Two minutes are added; the referee decided to grant a few extra minutes of stoppage time following the recent plays, since the clock had run out, and here are the highlights from those final minutes of the first half.
 Live updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 Key moments
 1:31 PM ET 44' Goal by Aleksey Batrakov · 2-2 
 1:27 PM ET 39' Goal by Soriba Diaoune · 2-1 
 1:09 PM ET 21' Yellow card 
 12:55 PM ET 7' Goal by Soriba Diaoune · 1-1 
 12:49 PM ET 2' Goal by Yunus Akgün · 0-1 
 12:45 PM ET 1' The game begins 
 Follow VAVEL on Google 44' 1:31 PM ET 2 minutes ago Galatasaray GOOOOOOOOAAAAAAAL
 The game was about to be tied, and it took just a few minutes for Aleksey Batrakov to score with a great header from close range right down the middle of the goal, following a superb cross into the box by Roland Sallai.
 ¡Batrakov lo empató tras un JUGADÓN de Sallai! 😮‍💨

 Live updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 40' 1:29 PM ET 4 minutes ago We're now in the final stretch of the game, and the home team holds the lead thanks to a brace by Diaoune; both teams continue to look for one more chance to score in this final stretch of the match...
 Live updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 39' 1:27 PM ET 7 minutes ago LOSC Lille's GOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAAL
 LOSC Lille has turned the game around, as just a moment ago young academy player Soriba Diaoune scored twice—first with a great right-footed shot from the center of the box—putting the home team up 2-1. 
 Live updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 36' 1:22 PM ET 11 minutes ago Victor Osimhen continues to make good plays, but he's always left on his own and can't finish them off. There are less than ten minutes left in the game, and both teams are still looking for a scoring opportunity.
 Live updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 32' 1:18 PM ET 16 minutes ago We're past the first thirty minutes of the game, and both teams are still looking for another chance. So far, the home team looks much better because they're trying harder; despite that, Galatasaray is still looking to score, as Nigerian Victor Osimhen drops back very well but finds himself alone.
 Live updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 28' 1:14 PM ET 19 minutes ago Galatasaray will have a chance to take the lead because just a moment ago the goalkeeper came out and touched the forward; the referee then checked the VAR to determine whether it was a goal or not, and ultimately disallowed it.
 Live updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 24' 1:10 PM ET 23 minutes ago The match remains very intense, and LOSC Lille continues to look for scoring opportunities. Just a moment ago, they had a chance off a corner kick, but the defense cleared it, and now they have another opportunity off the corner.
 Live updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 21' 1:09 PM ET 24 minutes ago The first yellow card of the match has already been issued: Nabil Bentaleb committed a hard foul and was shown a yellow card for dangerous play. The match is getting more heated, and both teams are looking to create more scoring opportunities at any moment.
 Live updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 20' 1:06 PM ET 27 minutes ago The match continues to be back-and-forth as both teams look to attack; just a moment ago, Benjamin André tried a through ball, but Dilane Bakwa was offside. Both teams are looking to take the lead in the first half.
 Live updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 16' 1:02 PM ET 32 minutes ago It's still a great game—both teams are continuing to create scoring chances. Just a moment ago, Nigerian Victor Osimhen tried a header from the center of the box, but it went too high. The game has slowed down a bit since the goals.
 Live updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 12' 12:57 PM ET 36 minutes ago We're witnessing a great game—it's been over ten minutes and we've already seen two goals, and both teams are playing very well; the game is going back and forth, and they keep looking for another chance to score more goals.
 Live updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 7' 12:55 PM ET 39 minutes ago LOSC Lille's GOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAAL
 What a crazy game we're witnessing—in just eight minutes, both teams have already scored. In the 7th minute, Soriba Diaoune fired a great low left-footed shot from the left side of the penalty area, right next to the left post.
 ¡Rapidito lo empataron los locales! 
Diaoune sacó al portero y definió con el arco abierto.
@cmrivass
@losclive 1-1 @GalatasaraySK https://t.co/6YkF3jScRD

 Live updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 4' 12:51 PM ET 42 minutes ago The match has remained very intense since the goal; they're very close to scoring a second. Just a moment ago, they had a great chance, but the LOSC Lille goalkeeper came out well and prevented that play from resulting in a goal. Let's hope for more action.
 Live updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 2' 12:49 PM ET 44 minutes ago Galatasaray GOOOOOOOOAAAAAAAL
 The visitors scored right off the bat: in the 2nd minute, Yunus Akgün fired a great left-footed shot from the center of the box right down the middle of the goal, opening the scoring in the opening minutes of the match, which is set to get intense.
 ¡No dieron ni tiempo de acomodarse! 
Yunus Akgün hizo el primero de los Turcos en Francia.
@cmrivass
@losclive 0-1 @GalatasaraySK https://t.co/yBgorfR73S

 Live updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 1' 12:45 PM ET an hour ago The game begins
 The match is underway; the ball is already rolling on the field, and the home team kicked off to gain possession right from the start. Both teams are looking for the win and to score goals, and they’ll give it their all to achieve that and gain the upper hand in these opening minutes.
 Live updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 12:28 PM ET an hour ago Stay tuned
 Everything is almost ready at the stadium to follow the broadcast on VAVEL.com, with every development on the field and the final score of the match on Matchday 3 of the UEFA Champions League, as they aim to earn three more points.

 12:16 PM ET an hour ago They're already checking out the field
 The players are almost ready to train ahead of the match and are checking out the field; both teams will give it their all to win this Matchday 3 clash in the UEFA Champions League, get off on the right foot this matchday, and secure a victory.
 Live updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 12:12 PM ET an hour ago Fans are already arriving
 Fans are already arriving for this big matchup on Matchday 3 of the UEFA Champions League, where both teams will give it their all and look to secure the win; it won’t be long before the match kicks off and both teams give their best to earn points in this game.

 12:08 PM ET an hour ago Galatasaray is arriving at the stadium
 The Galatasaray players are arriving at the stadium; they’ll be giving it their all to secure a win in this Matchday 3 game, thereby solidifying their victory and, in doing so, aiming to improve their record, build momentum, and continue on a positive streak in this competition.
